title: EHR Incentive Programs Q&A
description: Q&A regarding lack of face-to-face patient interaction or follow-up exception under the EHR Incentive Program.
body:
Q: Can EPs (Eligible Professionals) who are not anesthesiologists, pathologists and radiologists apply for the exception for lack of face to face patient interaction and lack of need for follow-up?

A: Yes this exception is open to any EP who meets both of these criteria (lack of face to face interactions and lack of follow up with patients). Medicare considers lack of face-to-face and need for follow up care to be situations where the EP has no or nearly no face to face patient interactions or need for follow up care. The EP would need to demonstrate either a complete lack of face-to-face interaction and follow-up or those cases of face-to-face interaction and follow-up are extremely rare and not part of normal scope of practice for that EP. EPs need to apply no later than July 1, 2014 to avoid the payment adjustment in 2015 although Medicare encourages EPs to apply well before the deadline.
